prompts.72:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE premium photorealistic book product photograph for an author's website, landscape 4:3 aspect ratio at highest native resolution. Image1 is the exact scene/style reference. Image2 is the flat print cover to apply to the new photographed book.
Recreate Image1's quiet cream architectural interior, pale travertine/marble tabletop, soft green foliage bokeh at the edges, warm natural diagonal morning sunlight, very subtle surface reflection and realistic soft grounding shadow. One standing physical paperback centered, front cover almost front-facing with narrow left spine visible, entirely in frame with comfortable margins, book occupies roughly80% of image height. Match Image1's camera angle and polished editorial quality. No other foreground books or extra props.
The book subject is "İLK 72 SAAT". Keep the exact white cover, black circular crosshair title İLK 72 SAAT, glass hourglass with gold sand and coins on the left, subtitle Next Generation Marketing’e Doğru Başlamanın El Kitabı, author line Emre Topçu & Ziya Şakir Yılmaz, yellow-star BEYAZ logo. Preserve the supplied cover artwork.
Apply the EXACT Image2 cover to the front of the physical book in perspective. Preserve every main Turkish character, correct book title, original author identity, original cover colors and composition; do not add text outside the book. Spine should carry the matching cover colors and title, with restrained realistic thickness. Do NOT copy Kurşun Geçirmez title or bamboo artwork from Image1 onto this different book. Do not recreate the artwork creatively. No floating book, no mockup frame, no watermark, no UI, no hands, no person outside the cover. Natural paper and print detail, sharp title, physically believable perspective. Output only the finished photograph.
